91.original: Ja son dovddai , ahte dat lea stuorimus elolaš , ja namma lea dan sámis Huika .
91.translation: And he knew that this had been the man with a big herd and the name of this Sámi was Huika .

99.original: And the Norwegians killed another Sámi , a man from Gárasavvon .
99.translation: Ja gal velá leat dážat goddán ovtta sámi , Gárasavvona vuloš sámi .

996.original: Čilgehus dasa manin galgá okta siida atnit guovtti sajis bohccuid .
996.translation: An Explanation of Why it is Necessary for a Siida to Divide the Reindeer into Two Parts .

997.original: Dat lea danin_go luovvasat leat nu hilbadat , ahte sin galgá višahit nu garrasit , dan sivas go luovvasat mannet beare njolggi ja čuoskku juohke guvlui , go lea velá čoaskkis ja unnán biebmu , headju jeagil ja bievllat unnán .
997.translation: The reason for this is that the male reindeer are so unruly that they must be managed harshly :  they trot and gallop all over the place when it is still cold out and there is little food ,  poor lichen growth and little open ground .

998.original: Ja áldoeallu lea váralaš ; dan galggalii sáhttit nu siivvut reainnidit go lea máŧolaš .
998.translation: And it is a dangerous time for the cow herd :  they must be herded as carefully as possible .

999.original: Jos áldduid šaddá višahit garrasit , de šaddet hilbadat , ja nubbi dat , ahte go áldduid šaddá višahit sakka , de reitojit , ja lea bahá beatnagat borret misiid .
999.translation: If the cow herd is managed harshly it will become unruly ,  and also ,  if the cows are driven in this way ,  they will go into labor early and the dogs are bad for eating the calves .

1000.original: Ja dat álddut , mat leat easka miesi njoallume , de dat ballájit eret miesi nalde , go beana oaguha garrasit dohko bohccuid .
1000.translation: And those cows that have not yet calved ,  and who are just giving birth ,  these will be frightened away from their calves when a dog comes chasing the reindeer hard .

3052.original: Stuora gávvila , nana nana nana voja voja nana nana nana , ii oktage diehtán , leago guolli dahe loddi , voja voja voja nana nana nana , stuora gávvila , voja voja nana , mieđábealde stuora bielluin guđodii , voja voja nana nana , bárdnelunttaid dorvu , go heahti bođii , go gávnnahalle suolabarggus , voja voja nana nana .
3052.translation: So cunning Nana nana nana voya voya nana nana nana Nobody knew if he was fish or fowl Voya voya voya nana nana nana So cunning voya voya nana He grazed his big bell reindeer down below ,  Voya voya nana nana A hideout for boys when in need When they are discovered stealing Voya voya nana nana .

3053.original: Ja bártnit háliide juohkehaš dan bártni iežaset mielde dan_dihte go son leai nu gávvil .
3053.translation: And the guys all wanted that guy along because he was so cunning .

3054.original: Ja dakka dan áigge veaháš riidale sámit gaskaneaset , ja suoláde nuppit nuppiin , ja nuppit sokče nuppiid , go nuppit ledje suoládeame .
3054.translation: And at that time the Sámi were striving against each other somewhat ,  and stealing from each other ,  and spying on each other when they were stealing .

3055.translation: And in this way they often got caught in the act of stealing .

3214.original: Loahppa lehkos Ipmila askkis , dego mánná lea eatni askkis , gos lea sus buoremus dorvu .
3214.translation: May they come in the end into God’s embrace ,  like a child in its mother’s arms ,  wherein lies its greatest protection .
